m.aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Śrī Rāmāde; victory to you, Lord Śrī Rāmāde. Your father is Ajmal, and your mother Menāde.
m.aarti.pad1: He whose form is charming rides a horse; a spear shines in his hand, and he wears pearls.
m.aarti.pad2: Lord, you are a form of Viṣṇu, come down as an incarnation in the Kali age; gods, men and sages meditate on you and give themselves to you.
m.aarti.pad3: In a moment you took away Dalajī's sorrow; you brought Bhāṇ back to life.
m.aarti.pad4: You brought the merchant's boat safely across and slew the demon; in a moment you made the lake salty.
